Rovers, landers, aircraft, and astronauts ..
Day 1 of the first-ever MAX POWER aerospace expo and air show was unforgettable! Thanks to the thousands who joined us to celebrate American innovation and technology at @NASAKennedy. Up next: Day 2. Stay tuned!
